text:
Type: open cube sideboard on metal base
Use: open storage for books, baskets, records or a TV; living room, dining room, hallway
Style: rustic, Scandinavian, industrial
Materials: solid pine with visible knots, grey back panels, grey powder-coated steel base
Colors: light natural pine, dark grey base and back
Shape: low wide frame with eight open square compartments in two rows, raised on a simple metal frame with four square legs, sturdy and open
Feel: warm, practical, honest, relaxed
Goes with: woven baskets, vinyl records, linen, black or grey metal; rustic, Scandinavian or industrial living rooms
